dt-example.title: Custom row rendering / aggregates
dt-example.info:
When displaying grouping rows with RowGroup, you aren't limited to just a single cell of data spanning the entire width of the table - you can insert a row that makes use of the columns defined in the host table by returning either a `-tag tr` element with the data you want to show.
This example demonstrates the creation a grouping row that contains aggregate data which aligns with the host table's columns, making it quick and easy for the end user to understand a summary of that data.
